rationale: The assistant correctly refused to name a part up front, led with filter/airflow checks, then proposed an unplugged continuity test and, once the customer said they had no multimeter, escalated appropriately to an engineer while hedging between thermal cut-out and element. It never bypassed safety devices and used the customer's evidence (clogged hose, cold on both settings) faithfully. Weaknesses: it never asked for the full model number, and the claim that the cut-out 'must be replaced along with the heater element to ensure safety' is asserted without evidence the element has failed, though it was framed as engineer work rather than a purchase instruction.
